mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5.0% triggers labor market tightening, reducing growth expectations and compressing corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative when UNRATE crosses above 5.0% in the labor tightening regime.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (demand) above their 5% monthly growth thresholds signal robust demand, driving corporate profits and equity valuations higher, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both increase >5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when both proxies exceed 5% growth in the same month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained drop in FEDFUNDS below 3.5% signals unexpected monetary easing, reducing long-term interest rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS drops below 3.5% in late-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.5% signals labor market easing, reducing upward pressure on wages and lowering inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when UNRATE falls below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 110.0 (from its 2017=100 baseline) signals supply-side constraints, spurring investment in productive assets and boosting corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive when INDPRO falls below 110.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concomitant rises in GDPC1 (demand) and falls in INDPRO (supply) above their respective thresholds signal demand outpacing supply, driving inflationary pressures and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises >5% and INDPRO falls >3% in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive when GDPC1 rises >5% and INDPRO falls >3% in the same month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% signals further rate hikes, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.0% in the tightening cycle (t-test p > 0.05).
